properties.name: Helderberg plateau private wells (Westerlo / Rensselaerville / Berne)
properties.receiving_water: Basic Creek or Ten Mile Creek depending on parcel side
properties.elev_source: USGS 3DEP at Rensselaerville Water Supply Dam 400 m away (1,500 ft)
properties.coord_source: REFERENCE POINT: Rensselaerville hamlet, on the Hannacroix/Catskill divide (user choice 2026-09-29)
properties.data_status: none (private) — one small coop system unverified
properties.topline_summary: Mostly private bedrock wells, no routine monitoring. CORRECTION: ECHO lists a "Westerlo Southside Water Coop" — a small community system does exist in the town; name/PWS ID to be confirmed with Town of Westerlo / NYS DOH.
properties.notes: Generic plateau private-well zone, not a specific property. Reference point for every km_from_ref column in the workbook. NYS DOH Albany Co. contact list shows no public water system in Westerlo.

properties.topline_summary: Sampled once, 2012-03-30; 3 field measurements. Inactive.
properties.notes: https://waterdata.usgs.gov/monitoring-location/USGS-422623074002801/

properties.name: Basic Creek Reservoir
properties.topline_summary: IMPAIRED: phosphorus (TMDL 2013), dissolved oxygen (303d 2022), iron. 15 HAB reports in 2025. Last published P values 2004–05.
properties.notes: DEC segment 1309-0001, Class A, 236.8 ac. Residence time 0.1 yr. DAM: high hazard, built 1928, 21 ft, max storage 3,922 ac-ft, drainage 16.76 sq mi; last inspected 2024-04-09, rated "Unsound – Deficiency Recognized" (DEC dam inventory).

properties.name: Alcove Reservoir
properties.topline_summary: Trophic state not assessed; no depth profiles; frequent blooms; 2 invasive plants. 3 HAB reports 2025.
properties.notes: Per Albany AWQR: 13.5 billion gal, avg depth 25 ft, max 75 ft, 17 mi shoreline; 6,500 acres of Water Board land around both reservoirs. Deep enough to stratify — opposite of Basic Creek (4 m). DAM: high hazard, 1929, 80 ft, 40,242 ac-ft, drainage 32.5 sq mi; 2024 inspection "No deficiencies noted".

properties.name: City of Albany water system (Alcove/Basic Creek → Feura Bush filtration)
properties.treatment: Alcove intake → Feura Bush plant: NaMnO4 + polyaluminum chloride, settling, filtration, chlorine (NaOCl since ~2019), pH/alkalinity corrosion control
properties.topline_summary: No MCL violations. TTHM LRAA 43–59 µg/L (2019–25). Lead 90th pct 13–17 µg/L; ACTION LEVEL exceeded 2023 (16.6; one tap at 196). PFOA/PFOS/dioxane/UCMR5 PFAS all ND. Pop. 101,866; 25,000 connections.
properties.notes: Basic Creek used only to augment Alcove level; AWQRs say no source restriction any year 2019–2025.

properties.name: Myosotis Lake (Rensselaerville)
properties.notes: DAM: high hazard, 1933, 22 ft, 1,975 ac-ft, drainage 6.57 sq mi; owner Huyck Preserve; 2024 "Unsound – Fair".

properties.name: Rensselaerville Water District
properties.coord_source: DEC dam inventory (Rensselaerville Water Supply Dam)
properties.treatment: Settling → NaMnO4 → slow sand → aeration (summer) → GAC → NaOCl; 50k gal clearwell
properties.topline_summary: No violations. TTHM range to 84.2 µg/L (MCL 80) — DOC signal. Lead 90th pct 9.3 µg/L.
properties.notes: Source flagged 'elevated susceptibility'. Intake impoundment: Rensselaerville Water Supply Dam on Ten Mile Creek, 4 ft, drainage 6.6 sq mi (low hazard, not rated).

properties.name: Greenville Water District No. 1
properties.topline_summary: No MCL violations (2024 AWQR filing lapse). Radium 0.82 pCi/L, barium 0.18, fluoride 0.43 — bedrock signature. Fe/Mn/nitrate/arsenic/PFAS ND.
properties.notes: 3 drilled wells; 260 connections.

properties.name: Cairo Water District
properties.topline_summary: No violations. PFOS 6.75 ng/L (NY MCL 10; EPA 4). Arsenic 2.7 µg/L (Well #3). m-Xylene 0.94 µg/L (2021).
properties.notes: Wells classified groundwater under influence of surface water.

properties.name: Catskill Creek (main stem)
properties.topline_summary: 2 HAB reports 9/6–9/24/2025 (unusual for a stream — low-flow signal).

properties.name: Potic Reservoir (Village of Catskill supply)
properties.topline_summary: High microbial susceptibility (pasture runoff); phosphorus-sensitive; aerator + settling basin being added to cut THM precursors.
properties.notes: Serves a Catskill-Creek-mouth town from a different drainage. DAM: high hazard, 1930, 37 ft, 1,550 ac-ft, drainage 19.6 sq mi; owner Village of Catskill; 2024 "Deficiently maintained".

properties.name: Village of Catskill water system
properties.treatment: Trident package filtration; NaMnO4, NaOH, coagulant, Cl2, Zn-orthophosphate
properties.topline_summary: TTHM MCL VIOLATION 2022 (LRAA 85–94 vs 80). Lead 90th pct 9.6 µg/L, some homes >15. PFOS 1.7 / PFOA 2.0 ng/L.
properties.notes: ~2,200 connections.

properties.notes: Candidate CSLAP site.

properties.name: Lawson Lake
properties.topline_summary: 3 HAB reports 7/23–8/8/2025.

properties.name: Basic Creek (stream, 6 DEC sites)
properties.topline_summary: Phosphorus, nitrate, iron, chloride 2008–2022 (11 events); nutrient biotic index 1995–2022 at 6 sites.
properties.notes: DEC DOW portal; values not yet pulled

properties.name: Warners Lake
properties.watershed: Fox Creek → Schoharie Creek (confirmed by dam inventory stream field)
properties.topline_summary: Full DO/temp profiles + HAB toxins 2012–2016; phosphorus 2001–2016.
properties.notes: DEC DOW portal DAM: intermediate hazard, 1964, 270 ac-ft, drainage 1.88 sq mi (stream: TR-Fox Creek → Schoharie — resolves the "verify"); 2024 "Unsound – Fair".

properties.name: Onderdonk Lake
properties.topline_summary: Phosphorus, chlorophyll, Secchi 2001–2025 (8 events); sampled 2025.
properties.notes: DEC DOW portal DAM: intermediate hazard, 1928, 280 ac-ft; multiple owners incl. Town of Westerlo; 2023 "Unsound – More Analysis needed".

properties.name: Sleepy Hollow Lake
properties.topline_summary: Best-monitored lake in the region: phosphorus 122 events, chlorophyll 129, Secchi 135, HAB toxins 2012–2022. The regional control series.
properties.notes: DEC DOW portal; 2 HAB reports 2025 DAM: high hazard, 1972, 83 ft, 13,500 ac-ft, drainage 13.3 sq mi (Murderers Creek); 2024 "No deficiencies noted".
